spending.recorded.description: Runs every time someone spends money on your stream: a tip, Super Chat, Super Sticker, rant, bits, Kicks, Jewels, a subscription, gift subs or a shop order. The amount is already changed into your chosen currency. Names on the Never list (like Anonymous) still run it. Good for thanking big spenders or showing a running total.

fields.platform: Only for this platform, like Twitch or Ko-fi. Leave it empty for every platform.
fields.minAmount: Only when the purchase is worth at least this much, in your chosen currency. 0 = every purchase.

variables.platform: Where they spent it, like Twitch, YouTube, Kick, Rumble, Streamlabs or Ko-fi
variables.label: What it was, like Cheer, Super Chat, Rant, Subscription or Gift subs
variables.amount: What it is worth, in your chosen currency, like 4.99
variables.formattedAmount: The amount with its currency sign, like $4.99
variables.paidAmount: What they actually paid: the money in their own currency, or the number of bits, Kicks, Jewels or subs
variables.paidCurrency: The currency they paid in, like EUR, or Bits, Kicks, Jewels, Subscription or GiftSubscription
variables.unit: What it was counted in: Money, Bits, Kicks, Jewels, Subscription or GiftSubscription
variables.quantity: How many: the money in their own currency, or the number of bits, Kicks, Jewels or subs
variables.tier: The sub tier (1, 2 or 3 on Twitch, the membership level on YouTube); empty for everything else
variables.streamTotal: Everything this person has spent this stream on that platform, in your currency
variables.rank: Their place on this stream's top spenders list (1 = the top spender)

spending.topSpenderChanged.description: Runs when somebody new becomes the top spender of this stream. Good for a "new top spender!" alert or chat message.

fields.scope: Which list. All platforms = the top spender across every platform changed. A platform name like Twitch = the top spender on that platform changed. Any = either.

variables.total: Everything they have spent this stream, in your chosen currency
variables.formattedTotal: The total with its currency sign, like $25.00
variables.previousUser: Who was the top spender before (empty when nobody was)
variables.previousPlatform: The platform of the previous top spender
variables.previousTotal: What the previous top spender had spent
variables.scope: Which list changed: All platforms, or the platform's name

spending.getTop.description: Gets the top spenders of this stream, today, this week, this month, this year or all time, on one platform or all of them. Good for a !topspender command or an end-of-stream thank you.

fields.period: Which time: This stream, Today, This week, This month, This year or All time. Days, weeks, months and years follow your computer's calendar.
fields.platform: One platform, like Twitch. Leave it empty for every platform together.
fields.count: How many people to get, from 1 to 100.

variables.topSpender: The name of the top spender (empty when nobody spent anything)
variables.topSpenderAmount: What the top spender spent, in your chosen currency
variables.topSpenderFormatted: The same with its currency sign, like $25.00
variables.topSpenders: Everyone on the list with their amounts, like Alice ($25.00), Bob ($10.00)
variables.topSpendersCount: How many people are on the list
variables.topSpendersTotal: What everyone on the list spent together
variables.topSpendersFormattedTotal: The same with its currency sign
variables.topSpendersJson: The whole list as JSON, for code steps
variables.topSpender1: The first place's name (topSpender2 is second place, and so on; also topSpender1Platform, topSpender1Amount and topSpender1Formatted)
variables.spendingPeriod: The period the list is for, like This week

spending.newStream.description: Starts a new stream for the top spenders right now: "this stream" lists start empty and the exchange rates are fetched again. Cuebot does this by itself when you go live, so you only need it if your platform does not tell Cuebot.

spending.add.description: Adds a purchase by hand, like a cash gift or a sale Cuebot cannot see. It counts toward the top spenders like any other purchase.

fields.platform: The platform to list them under. Leave it empty for Manual.
fields.currency: The currency, like EUR. Leave it empty for your chosen currency.
fields.label: What it was, like Cash gift.

spending.remove.description: Removes what one person spent, for example after a refund or a test. Good with a mod-only command.

fields.platform: Only on this platform. Leave it empty for every platform.
fields.period: Only purchases in this time, like This stream. All time removes everything they ever spent.
